title: TriadicFrameworks MCP — L3 Forces Unseen Drift Schema
description: Defines the schema for force-regime drift, including gradient drift, influence drift, coherence drift, and rupture drift.
note: This schema governs unseen force-state drift evaluation.

schema.name: forceRegimeDrift
schema.purpose: Analyze drift within unseen force regimes and compute drift-state metrics.

gradientDrift.description: Change in directional causal gradient over time.

fieldDrift.description: Change in unseen influence field coherence.

continuityDrift.description: Change in influence continuity across transitions.

ruptureDrift.description: Change in rupture potential within the force regime.

driftStability.description: Overall stability of drift within the force regime.

driftCoherence.description: Coherence of drift across unseen force fields.

reality.details: Drift metrics computed from gradientDrift, fieldDrift, continuityDrift, and ruptureDrift.
